Authorization: the popup on 401/403, token renewal, sign in through F5, Copy details

401: after Log out in another tab the next request shows the popup, the widgets stay on screen
OIDC provider is down: "Sign in again" and "Sign out" keep the popup open and say so, what is on the screen is not lost
AUTH_ERROR_MODE = soft. 401: the cross closes the popup, and further failing requests do not reopen it for a while
Copy details on the popup: the JSON has session, screen, view, request, status and timings
Copy details on a system error popup (500): the response body is shown in the expanded details
403: sign in of a user without roles shows the popup on the start page instead of an endless spinner, "Sign out" leads to the login page

The provider returns without our sign_in_callback parameter SIGN_IN_CALLBACK_DETECTION = SIGN_IN_CALLBACK_PARAM
401 from the backend: the access token is over for real, the backend refuses it, the popup is shown
The same without the iframe: the popup is offered, the burnt token is never sent a second time, "Sign in again" needs no password
401: with the SSO session over, "Sign in again" opens the login page, signing in restores the application
Copy details on a business error popup (a record that does not exist)
401 in two tabs: after signing in through one of them, "Sign in again" in the other needs no password and keeps that session
The provider is broken during the sign in: the sign in restarts 2 times and stops at the popup, no endless redirects
OIDC provider unreachable: the refresh token is sent once and never again, the popup comes up, "Sign in again" needs no password
The refresh token is burnt but the cookie is good: the iframe picks the renewal up and the user sees nothing
403: roles removed in the OIDC provider while the user works; the next token renewal ends in the popup, with the roles back "Sign in again" restores the work without a password
